audit_trigger: independent post-result audit after the original report and all headline outcomes were visible

visible_before_this_amendment: all original endpoint, aggregate, interval, support, and promotion results
the original 37.1757 Hz/s inclusive-current quadratic RMSE and 0.127492 ratio
a noncanonical read-only strict-past sensitivity near 35.80 Hz/s and ratio 0.123
the original maximum calibration score 25.725265 from 12 calibration groups
the fact that no frozen endpoint occurs after the 1.1 s CFO step plus the 0.5 s exclusion
post_outcome_disclosure.interpretation: This is a transparent scientific correction, not a preregistered independent confirmation. The corrected rerun may repair claim validity but cannot erase post-outcome knowledge or create a new holdout.

audit_findings.finding: The requested 95% split-conformal order is ceil((12+1)*0.95)=13, which is unavailable from 12 calibration groups; capping at order 12 does not provide a finite-sample 95% guarantee. The deterministic factor-balanced C/E split also does not establish exchangeability.
The quadratic implementation included the endpoint even-Qin measurement although the frozen protocol required strict-past frames.
The frozen 0.5 s step-transition exclusion was not applied. Frozen endpoints at 0.5, 1.0, and 1.5 s provide two pre-step and one transition endpoint, with no post-exclusion endpoint after 1.6 s.
Promotion gates did not explicitly require identical evaluable scenario/endpoint identifiers for quadratic versus fixed500 or row-exact cloned point fields for the interval diagnostic.

frozen_corrections_before_rerun.strict_past_quadratic: For every target endpoint, fit only supported even-Qin frames with reference_time_s strictly less than the endpoint time and within the trailing 0.5 s window; evaluate the fitted derivative at the excluded endpoint time. Keep all other quadratic thresholds and robust-fit settings unchanged.
frozen_corrections_before_rerun.finite_sample_95_interval: Compute required_order=ceil((n+1)*0.95). When required_order>n, formally abstain: publish no finite 95% multiplier or coverage claim. Preserve the order-n maximum-score interval only as an explicitly descriptive diagnostic, with no conformal or distribution-free interpretation.
frozen_corrections_before_rerun.step_diagnostic: Label each step endpoint no_step, pre_step, transition_excluded, or post_exclusion using the frozen 1.1 s step time and 0.5 s exclusion. Report the mixed pre/transition population and the transition-only stratum separately; make no recovery inference because no post_exclusion endpoint exists.
frozen_corrections_before_rerun.identity_gates: Require exact equality of primary evaluable scenario identifiers and complete endpoint identifiers before any quadratic ratio PASS. Require row-exact equality of every non-interval point/truth/status field between fixed500 and its descriptive interval clones.
frozen_corrections_before_rerun.decision_rule: The original fixed500 combined status remains FAIL regardless of the rerun. The quadratic result may retain PASS only under the original 0.95 RMSE-ratio threshold and the newly explicit identical-ID gates; it must be described as a corrected post-outcome component result, not independent confirmation.

retuning_forbidden: changing scenarios, seeds, SNR, occupancy, rate, acceleration, jerk, aliases, CFO steps, or sample-clock offsets
changing supported-frame thresholds, history length, fit order, robust-fit tuning, endpoint targets, primary mask, or original numeric promotion thresholds
using odd-Qin responses for fitting, support, endpoint selection, calibration, or gates
opening holdout_foundation, newer captures, or any capture/span outside the three exact original bindings
execution_requirement: After implementation and focused tests are committed, freeze a separate hash-bound corrective execution authority, then rerun all 36 scenarios from a clean tree. Preserve all failures and regenerate every canonical row artifact, metric, report, and PNG.
